categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Feiliks International Logistics Inc. primarily operates in two main segments: comprehensive logistics services and international freight forwarding logistics services. The comprehensive logistics services include inbound logistics, production logistics, finished goods logistics, land transportation and warehousing, multimodal transport, value-added services, outsourcing, global after-sales spare parts logistics, and green circular packaging. The international freight forwarding segment covers sea freight, air freight, and Yangtze River shipping services, providing door-to-door integrated supply chain solutions globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced logistics technologies including automated warehouses with IoT, RFID, AGV (Automated Guided Vehicles), AI-driven intelligent stacking systems, and 5G-enabled smart manufacturing. It has developed a digital management platform, order management system (OMS), robotic process automation (RPA), and integrated customs clearance systems. These technologies enable efficient inventory management, real-time tracking, and seamless integration with customers' production lines, enhancing supply chain visibility and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Feiliks serves primarily intelligent manufacturing enterprises, focusing on electronic information manufacturing, automotive and auto parts, and new energy industries such as photovoltaics. Key customers include global and domestic brand manufacturers, suppliers, and distributors in these sectors. The company also serves global after-sales spare parts logistics needs for major brands and has expanded into Southeast Asia, North America, and other international markets to support customers' overseas production bases.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant presence in Suzhou, Shanghai, Southwest China, and other regions. Internationally, it has established operations and service networks in Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia), North America, Europe, and other countries. It maintains a global logistics network covering over 50 countries and regions across five continents, with strategic hubs in the Greater Bay Area and other key logistics centers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Feiliks operates primarily as a midstream and downstream logistics service provider within the supply chain. It offers integrated supply chain management solutions including warehousing, transportation, customs clearance, and value-added services, acting as a critical logistics partner for manufacturers and brand owners. The company also provides international freight forwarding services, connecting upstream suppliers with downstream markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening industry specialization, expanding overseas operations, and enhancing digital transformation through data governance and AI applications. It prioritizes developing core logistics products tailored to key industries, advancing green supply chain initiatives, and building intelligent, automated warehousing and transportation systems. R&D efforts concentrate on digital management platforms, supply chain collaboration systems, customs clearance automation, and smart logistics technologies to improve efficiency and customer value.
categories.revenue_model: Feiliks generates revenue primarily through service fees from comprehensive logistics operations and international freight forwarding. This includes charges for warehousing, transportation, customs brokerage, value-added logistics services, and supply chain management solutions. Revenue is recognized based on contract terms upon fulfillment of service obligations, typically on a monthly billing cycle with invoicing after customer confirmation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading professional logistics and supply chain management service provider in China’s intelligent manufacturing sector. It ranks among the top in China for international freight forwarding and logistics warehousing revenue, recognized as a top private logistics enterprise. Its competitive advantages include extensive warehousing resources, advanced automation, comprehensive global network, and strong industry-specific expertise, differentiating it from traditional logistics providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Feiliks reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.02 billion, a 25.81% decrease from 2022, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 21.8 million, down 79.74%. Despite revenue decline due to external market pressures and exchange rate fluctuations, the company maintains a total asset base of about RMB 3.84 billion and equity of RMB 1.48 billion. It continues to invest in automation and overseas expansion, aiming for stable growth and enhanced profitability through operational efficiencies and strategic initiatives.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Feiliks emphasizes creating customer value through integrated, end-to-end supply chain solutions tailored to intelligent manufacturing industries. Its differentiation lies in deep industry expertise, advanced digital and automation technologies, extensive warehousing and transportation networks, and commitment to green logistics. The company offers highly customized, flexible logistics services with strong operational control, enabling clients to reduce costs, improve efficiency, and achieve supply chain visibility and sustainability.
